answer:
Here is what I would raise at your check-up, most important first.

1. Lung nodule follow-up looks missed. The CT you had for the kidney stone on October 18, 2025 also found a 7 mm solid nodule in the lower right lung. The radiologist advised a chest CT in 6 to 12 months, so the window ran from about April to October 2026 and has now closed. I can't find a chest CT or any mention of the nodule afterward. You've never smoked, which is reassuring, but this still needs to be scheduled or at least discussed soon.

2. Hydrochlorothiazide may still be on your list. You were hospitalized in March 2026 with a sodium of 123 and a fall, and the water pill hydrochlorothiazide was stopped. But the eye clinic's May 2026 list shows it as something you take, and your June 2026 sodium was still slightly low at 134. Please confirm with your doctor whether you are taking it. If you aren't, the lists need correcting. If you are, that needs attention. It would also be sensible to record it as a drug that caused you a problem.

3. The thyroid recheck wasn't done. Your TSH was high (7.9) during the hospital stay, and they asked for TSH and free T4 to be repeated 6 to 8 weeks later (by about late April 2026). I find no repeat, including in June when you had other blood tests. Free T4 was normal at the time. Illness can raise TSH temporarily, but it needs rechecking.

4. Diabetes care has gaps. Your A1c is 6.6%, improved from 6.9%, and your eye exam in May 2026 showed no retinopathy (next one due May 2027). I find no urine albumin test (kidney check), no foot exam, and no record of the diabetes education referral being completed.

5. Cholesterol hasn't been followed up. In September 2025 your LDL was 142 and HDL 48. With diabetes at your age, a cholesterol-lowering medicine is usually discussed, and no one has recorded that or rechecked your levels.

6. Vaccines. You had flu, pneumococcal (Prevnar 20) and the first Shingrix on November 8, 2025. The second Shingrix dose (due 2 to 6 months after the first) isn't recorded, and this season's flu shot isn't recorded yet. I see no COVID, Tdap or hepatitis B vaccines either; those may just be recorded elsewhere.

7. Screenings I can't find: mammogram and cervical screening. Your colonoscopy in 2019 was normal, with the next one due around 2029, so that is on track.

8. Follow-up after the hospital stay and the kidney stone. Both discharge notes asked for a primary care visit within 1 to 2 weeks (hospital) and 1 week (stone). Your June clinic note doesn't mention either. Your kidney stone is still listed as active, and I find no record that it passed. Tell your doctor if you've had further pain or blood in the urine.

9. Records that don't match. Lisinopril still shows as active in one hospital record, though it was stopped in September 2025 for cough, and the cough is also listed as an allergy-type reaction. Your clinic's June plan says 'continue current medications' without mentioning the hospital stay or the stopped hydrochlorothiazide, so it may not have seen the hospital records. Amlodipine start dates also differ between sources.

Your blood pressure was 128/80 in June, at goal. The clinic planned to see you again in about 6 months, so around December 2026.
short: Please review: a 7 mm right lung nodule from the October 2025 CT never had its advised chest CT follow-up; hydrochlorothiazide, stopped after hyponatremia in March 2026, still appears on a May 2026 medication list, with sodium 134 in June; the repeat TSH after 7.9 was never done; and diabetes checks (urine albumin, foot exam), cholesterol/statin review, Shingrix dose 2, and mammogram/cervical screening are not recorded.
